svg.title: Change Impact Intelligence — TeamFlow example
svg.desc: Illustrative TeamFlow report IMP-001. The agent-selected starting file is taskAssignmentService.ts. taskRoutes.ts and bulkTaskService.ts import it directly; projectOperations.ts imports bulkTaskService.ts, so it is an indirect dependent two hops away. Analysis traverses these import edges in reverse from the starting file, up to two hops by default in the MVP. DEC-001 is linked to the starting file. The report is a snapshot with source locations and limits. Separately, the agent records AI predictions: a possible conflict with DEC-001 and a possible need for a leave-status interface.
